task.description: Repeat the operator task in <= 12 words.

summary.description: Natural-language status of what you are doing this turn.

summary_updates.description: Short chronological progress updates (can be empty).

actions.description: Ordered actions to perform this turn. Emit a single `finish` action (no others) when the task is complete.

type.description: The action kind. read_file/list_dir/search_text/web_research are auto-run; write_file/edit_file/run_cmd require operator approval; finish ends the session.

reason.description: Why this action is needed (shown to the operator).

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path for read_file/list_dir/write_file/edit_file (never absolute, no `..`).

content.description: Full file content for write_file, or the whole-file replacement for edit_file when no anchor is given.

anchor.description: For edit_file: the exact existing text to locate and replace. Must occur exactly once in the file.

replacement.description: For edit_file: the text that replaces `anchor`.

query.description: Search query for web_research. Use it before choosing unfamiliar or time-sensitive libraries.

max_results.description: Maximum web results to return for web_research (default 5).

expected_hash.description: Optional sha256 of the file content you last read, guarding edit_file against concurrent changes.

needs_more_context.description: True when you cannot proceed without more of the repo.

missing_snippets.description: Minimal repo-relative files/snippets required before proceeding (e.g. src/index.js).
